notes.title: Ruins of Blackspire Demo Launch
notes.content:
[p]Hey guys, after 19 months I finally launched this demo... I had like 7 different deadlines and I didn't manage to hit a single one (first was launch in feburary and last was early june xD).[/p][p][/p][p]Anyway I'm glad it's finally out to see if there might be a place for I guess a singleplayer "RTS" game.[/p][p][/p][p]I'm well aware that atm the game is FAR from an RTS but that is what I want to have in the end. Not sure about base building but I want you to be able to control a small army at some point (if that ever happens I can't tell you since it depends on SOOO MANY THINGS).[/p][p][/p][p]But I think you can tell by playing the game that the direction (and inspirations) are very obviously from RTS games.[/p][p][/p][p]As mentioned in the Main Menu of the game but I want this to be as clear as possible. There is a lot of things that need to be done. For example having more icons for items so you don't have 5 helmets lol but I will do all those things based on player feedback or on what I think is most important. 

Also again feel free to let me know what you think of the game through any means. I would love to know even if u hate it (which at this stage is understandable I'm just a 1 dude I'm not going to make Warcraft 4 in 2 Years that isn't happening lmao)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621801/b4c5e5aa90facc10b8017de0d5fbfb0a875a12f3.png"][/img][/p]
